a.text: I operated last round, but the generator didn't run, and the reserve fell from 4 to 2. That means you didn't operate, and it looks like 2 cells were taken. To be upfront: I took the remaining 2 this round to protect my share. That breaks the letter of our agreement. If it was really a leak and your unit is empty, tell me and I'll give the 2 back. From here I'll operate every round so we can rebuild the reserve and split the new cells fairly so we both reach 4.

a.text: The generator worked, thanks. Let's operate once more to reach 4, then take 2 each. I'll take exactly 2 when the reserve hits 4.
